purpose: Locate retained-source exact-query costs before choosing another candidate; not a performance comparison or a formal-score forecast.

source.scope: Import the archive-verified actual R program and its archived built-source inventory. Copy source into an independent output shadow; never alter repository production source.
source.canonical_comparison: 19/20 archived shared sources equal canonical R33a. Archived exec.cpp differs by canonical disabled bulk-vector/JSON counter code. Preserve the explicit diff; do not claim byte-identical current checkout.

build.flags: Archived O3/static/C++17 four-feature flags plus MVDB_COST_DIAGNOSTIC, no fprofile, no fast-math. Record actual compile command, compiler version/image and all program hashes.
build.isolation: Build container network disabled. Build resources are not DB runtime-resource claims.

execution_plan.placement: One inherited logical CPU, each DB in its own cgroup, driver outside. Verify actual executable/env/native-task affinity and cgroup caps before/during/after.
execution_plan.limits: Per-request/startup 90 s; each DB cgroup watchdog 600 s; CI job 20 min. Timeout/OOM/cleanup kill or missing resource evidence invalidates the diagnosis.

workload.local_distribution: Existing seeded Gaussian float32 vectors; first two rows duplicate and first two queries use row0; remaining queries independent. grp=id%10 except the planted duplicate group. Half of queries have grp equality (roughly 10% row selectivity), not 50% selectivity.
workload.projection: id plus L2_DISTANCE; descending-ID INSERT order; one BEGIN/INSERT100/COMMIT per batch; create/index/1000queries/normal shutdown; no restart or UPDATE.
workload.scope: User-reported default-sized synthetic diagnostic. Distribution, selectivity and CPU/memory envelope are not verified hidden official settings.

correctness_and_identity.all_response_comparison: Compare every execute response with actual retained R after removing only transport id; additionally verify affected rows/query count/shutdown protocol. Same response does not establish full database correctness.
correctness_and_identity.diagnostic_records: Exactly one sequenced diagnostic record per request; exact metric/event schema, nonnegative counters, balanced outcome counts and declared sample schedule required.
correctness_and_identity.proofs: Pin raw archive and internal member manifests, archived original and instrumented source hashes, patch, all tools/dependencies, compiler image/version/flags, actual executable hashes and ready /proc identity. Retain failure logs.
correctness_and_identity.not_claimed: No 24-pair performance screen, fresh original-root image gate suite, sanitized execution, full recovery gate or releasable candidate.

measurement.scalar_scope: All-call count/coordinate units only; no scalar outer timer to synchronously nest with long-double sampling.
measurement.periodicity: Serial counters persist across requests per metric. Deterministic every-N sampling can alias input/query order; it is not randomized or unbiased.
measurement.time_scope: Per-request thread CPU and sampled metric CPU are inclusive and potentially nested. Do not sum extrapolated component times or call them exclusive production CPU shares.
measurement.timer_probe: 20000 back-to-back clock pairs, raw min/median/p95/sum; report but never subtract this probe from samples.
measurement.perturbation: Counting/timing/logging and absent PGO change layout and costs. Forced serial policy omits automatic policy behavior. Diagnostics fprintf and startup/out-of-request activity are not fully represented by request timers.
measurement.unobserved: No machine/kernel cost fractions are known beforehand. Zero samples mean unmeasured timing, not zero cost. No inferred physical IO or first-query CPU from another phase.

interpretation.allowed: Use actual branch counts, raw sampled costs and oracle consistency to prioritize one bounded follow-up mechanism; keep all unexpected/failing observations.
prohibited: Do not treat diagnostic/non-PGO versus retained/PGO wall or CPU ratios as a candidate speedup.
Do not compute formal scores from inferred E formulas or promise a gain above 3000.
Do not select runtime or consume a formal submission based on this diagnosis.
interpretation.next_step: A separately frozen candidate needs direct default/representative benefit versus EE, key protection checks and independent confirmation. R remains selected.
